children: Grayscale CoinDesk Crypto 5 ETF reported a net decrease in net assets from operations of $(253.8M) for the year ended June 30, 2026, a sharp reversal from gains of $250.3M in FY2025 and $254.3M in FY2024 as market declines and redemptions pressured assets under management.
Net income: $(253.8M) net decrease in net assets resulting from operations for year ended June 30, 2026 (vs. +$250.3M in FY2025 and +$254.3M in FY2024).
Diluted EPS: Not reported in Part 2 Item 7/Item 8; omitted.
Revenue: Not reported in Part 2 Item 7/Item 8; omitted.
Listing & liquidity: The Fund began trading on NYSE Arca on Sept. 19, 2025 and launched an ongoing creation/redemption program intended to improve market liquidity.
Index methodology change: The Fund adopted the CD5 index methodology on June 5, 2025, replacing prior DLCS/target coverage rules and triggering rebalances and changes to fund components.
AUM & flows: Net assets fell roughly 60% to $309M in FY2026, driven by market price declines and substantial redemptions; creations partially offset outflows.

Operational controls & valuation: The Fund established a principal market selection process, an ASC 820 fair‑value valuation process with quarterly reviews, and T+1/T+2 settlement procedures for creations and redemptions.
Fees & expenses: The manager assumed the majority of Fund expenses; the only ordinary expense recorded was the manager’s fee, which was paid partly in digital assets.
